Enforcement is **live**, not disabled. ⚠️ **Open (CR-3, unbuilt):** nothing runs `bash -n` over `~/.claude/scripts/*.sh` before they take effect. A hook with deny power can brick the machine, and it needs a syntax gate + a Tier-3 smoke test at install — same class as ledger #15/#17, where a *named but unbuilt* hardening recurred two days later.
